purpose: Independent prescribed-forcing positive-gap PDE tests at P=2 and sigma=1
pde: -u''+u+lambda*(sinh(u)-u)=f on R, approximated by zero Dirichlet solve_bvp on [-14,14]

methods.C: identical stable pair plus persistent collision flag and 1% state/summable energy safeguard, then h=0

initialization: beta uniform[-0.8,0.8], h uniform[0.1,1.2], shared across methods; coefficients refit to PDE energy
training: Simpson quadrature on [-12,12], 2401 nodes; beta in [-3,3], half-gap in [1e-6,3]; L-BFGS-B maxiter=300,maxfun=1000,gtol=1e-10,ftol=1e-14; normalize by max(1,||f||_L2^2)
completion: scan every 5 iterations and local returns, 2 consecutive flags; diameter<=0.5 and normalized pair Gram smallest sqrt eigenvalue<=0.1; state change<=0.01||v||_H1 and actual energy increase<=0.0005||f||_L2^2
validation: solve_bvp tol 1e-9 on [-14,14], compare 1e-10 solve on [-16,16]; evaluate solution/error/energy on 6401 nodes [-16,16] and check quadrature refinement
honesty: All pilot cases retained. Reserved seeds untouched until a separate confirmation choice is frozen. No global-optimality claim from local multistarts.
